units.source_text: 源氏公子渐觉世路艰辛，不如意之事越来越多；

en.t: Prince Genji gradually came to feel how hard the path of life had become, and more and more things went against his wishes;

units.source_text: 如果装作无动于衷，隐忍度日，深恐将来遭逢更惨的命运。

en.t: if he pretended to be unmoved and endured the days in silence, he deeply feared that an even more wretched fate would await him in the future.

units.source_text: 他想自动离开京都，避居须磨。

en.t: He thought of leaving Kyoto of his own accord and withdrawing to live in Suma.

units.source_text: 这地方在古昔曾有名人卜居，但听说现今早已荒凉，连渔人之家也很稀少。

en.t: In ancient times, famous men had once chosen that place as their dwelling, but he had heard that by now it had long been desolate, with even fishermen's houses very few.

units.source_text: 住在繁华热闹的地方，又不合乎避地的本意；

en.t: To live in a prosperous and lively place would not accord with the true purpose of withdrawing from the world;

units.source_text: 到离开京都遥远的地方去，又难免怀念故里，牵挂在京的那些人。

en.t: yet if he went somewhere far away from Kyoto, he could hardly avoid longing for his old home and worrying about those people who remained in the capital.

units.source_text: 因此踌躇不决，心乱如麻。

en.t: Because of this, he hesitated and could not decide, his heart tangled in confusion.
